method: Equal-dimension, provenance-label-blinded comparison recorded before unsealing the key or receiving the independent confirmation.
limitation: The author has prior visual familiarity and may recognize content differences; this is label-blinded, not a claim of complete perceptual blinding.

hierarchy.reason: Primary labels are stronger than connector labels, without a giant heading or auxiliary prose.

density.reason: The same two-column rhythm, row centers and exterior margins survive. B includes one concise subordinate line without expanding the canvas.

typography.reason: B is visibly larger rather than pixel-identical, but remains consistent, well aligned and comfortably contained; clearer primary/secondary separation offsets A's quieter type.

card_craft.reason: Both retain compact warm cards, normalized outlined icons and semantic accent strips; B adds only restrained depth.

routing.reason: Review and blocked labels belong visibly to their routes; separated return paths remove the ambiguity of overlapping opposite-direction trunks.

overall_polish.reason: Both look like a coherent polished Fluent diagram family. B no longer has the large-heading, prose-card or generic-symbol failure of the rejected migration.

approval_scope: One calibration candidate only; not permission to resume mass authoring or promote public assets.
